annotations.title: Ask the Mostly Right support agent

description: Ask the Mostly Right support agent a question about building a dataset: a failed run, an unsupported source shape, a refusal you do not understand. It reads the platform's source, its capabilities and your workspace's runs (name them in run_ids), and may file a problem for the Mostly Right team. Returns a question_id at once; call get_support_answer with it. Example: {"question": "Why did this run fail with CHECK_FAILED?", "run_ids": ["<run id>"]}. Counts against the workspace's daily support questions.
name: ask_support
title: Ask the Mostly Right support agent
